cases.purpose: Individually retain status and diagnostic for malformed try-lock size: missing.
cases.oracle: Documented mlock try-lock size contract: usage status 2, no stdout, and the specified diagnostic.
cases.comparison: Each independent case retains the actual status, stdout, stderr; the script checks all three and preserves the observed status on assertion failure.
cases.setup_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
cases.candidate_script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
expected='try-lock: SIZE argument required (bytes, 1..1048576)'
[[ $(type -t mlock) == builtin ]] || exit 125
mlock try-lock  >"$HOME/operation.out" 2>"$HOME/operation.err"
rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$HOME/operation.status" || exit 125
text=$(<"$HOME/operation.err")
[[ $rc == 2 && ! -s "$HOME/operation.out" && $text == *"$expected" ]] || exit 1
printf 'invalid missing ok\n'
